column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-13 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the deployment corpus rows and mutant names the run read
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase13/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase13_gate.py implements
# The 30 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. The eighteen
# corpus deployments split across the two surfaces that consume them — the capability-shape
# corpus and the byte-locked goldens — because both read the same rows for different
# purposes and neither is evidence for the other.
# None has a corpus row, a mutant, or a metric of its own, so the ledger carries them
# UNVERIFIED. The gap is recorded against Phase 13 in legacy_tracking_for_deletion.md.
